The exchanges underscored the importance of public-private partnership as a strategic imperative to Securing ASEAN’s Digital Future.

We thank the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore for this collaboration.

raw.text: As AI advances, so must the work to ensure its developed and used responsibly. The latest Responsible AI Transparency Report looks at how we're strengthening the policies, practices, and governance needed to help ensure AI remains worthy of people's trust.

reshared_post.text:
Today, we published our 2026 Responsible AI Transparency Report. 
  
One of the clearest lessons from our work is that responsible AI governance is not a destination. It’s an ongoing discipline that must evolve alongside the technology itself. 
  
This year’s report shares how we’ve re-engineered our Responsible AI Standard to address emerging AI capabilities, strengthened our risk-based approach to governance, and continued to translate what we’re learning into the tools, practices, and processes that help operationalize responsible AI across Microsoft. 
  
While technology continues to evolve, our AI principles remain a constant foundation. They guide how we approach new challenges, evaluate risks, and build accountability into our work.
  
Transparency is an important part of that process. By sharing our progress, challenges, and lessons learned, our goal is to contribute to stronger AI governance across the broader ecosystem.
  
No organization can do this alone. Advancing responsible AI will require continued collaboration, shared learning, and collective action across industry, government, academia, and civil society.
  
I encourage you to learn more about the report here: https://lnkd.in/ekStFTyg

raw.text:
What does it take to power the digital experience behind one of the world's biggest sporting events? 🎾

For the past 10 years, Jenna has been helping bring the US Open experience to life for millions of fans around the world.

As an Experience Consultant, her role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology and execution. Behind every match, she collaborates with developers, scoring providers, designers, video teams and countless partners to help deliver the digital experiences fans rely on throughout the tournament.

In the months leading up to the US Open, the focus is on planning, testing and preparing for every scenario imaginable. Once play begins, everything shifts into real time. Jenna works closely with teams across the program to monitor the experience, respond to challenges and help keep everything running seamlessly as the action unfolds.

It's a side of the US Open that most fans never see, but one that requires constant collaboration, adaptability and attention to detail.

And after a decade behind the scenes, Jenna still finds the energy, excitement and scale of the US Open unlike anything else. 🌎🎾

#USOpen #LifeAtIBM #IBMConsulting #SportsTech
